claims.text: The Merrion is a restoration of four Georgian townhouses.

findings.quote: An impeccable restoration of four Georgian townhouses

claims.text: The four townhouses were built in 1756 on Upper Merrion Street.

findings.quote: The Merrion’s story begins in 1756, when four Georgian townhouses were built on Upper Merrion Street

claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Georgian Dublin, opposite Government Buildings.

findings.quote: This 5 star luxury hotel is to be found in the heart of Georgian Dublin, opposite Government Buildings

findings.quote: a few minutes’ walk from galleries, museums, the I.F.S.C, Dublin Convention Centre, pubs, restaurants and the shops of Grafton Street
